<script>
(function() {
  var SERVER_URL = 'https://ringostat-webhook.onrender.com';
  var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  
  var utm = {
    source: params.get('utm_source'),
    medium: params.get('utm_medium'),
    campaign: params.get('utm_campaign'),
    content: params.get('utm_content'),
    term: params.get('utm_term')
  };
  
  var gclid = params.get('gclid') || null;
  
  // Получаем GA4 Client ID (БЕЗ gtag API)
  var gaid = (function() {
    try {
      // Способ 1: Из dataLayer (если GA4 передает туда)
      if (window.dataLayer) {
        for (var i = window.dataLayer.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
          if (window.dataLayer[i] && window.dataLayer[i].client_id) {
            return window.dataLayer[i].client_id;
          }
        }
      }
      
      // Способ 2: Парсим GA4 cookie (_ga)
      // Формат: _ga=GS2.1.XXXX или _ga=G1.1.XXXX
      var gaMatch = document.cookie.match(/_ga=G[^.]+\.\d+\.([^;]+)/);
      if (gaMatch) return gaMatch[1];
      
      // Способ 3: Парсим специфичный GA4 cookie (_ga_XXXXXXXXXX)
      var ga4Match = document.cookie.match(/_ga_[A-Z0-9]+=/);
      if (ga4Match) {
        var cookieName = ga4Match[0].replace('=', '');
        var cookieMatch = document.cookie.match(new RegExp(cookieName + '=GS\\d+\\.\\d+\\.([^;]+)'));
        if (cookieMatch) return cookieMatch[1];
      }
      
      return null;
    } catch(e) { 
      return null; 
    }
  })();
  
  var notDevC = !utm.content || !utm.content.toLowerCase().includes('dev_c');
  
  if (!gaid || !notDevC) {
    return;
  }
  
  var visitData = {
    gaid: gaid,
    gclid: gclid,
    utm: utm,
    landing: window.location.href,
    referrer: document.referrer || null
  };
  
  fetch(SERVER_URL + '/visit', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(visitData)
  });
})();
</script>
